let composite = LIST(limit + 6)

(0::limit + 6) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2::limit + 6 do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= (limit + 6) / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= limit + 6 do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value >= 2 /\ !composite[value]

primes() -> Pipe[int] => (2..limit) |> filter(is_prime)

    primes()
        |> map(first => group_from(first, size))
        |> filter(members =>
            members[size - 1] < limit /\ (members |> all(is_prime)))

show(values: Iterable[List[int]]) -> string =>
    values |> map(members => "({members |> join(" ")})") |> join(" ")

    let extra = values.count - wanted in
    values |> skip(if extra > 0 then extra else 0 fi)

    let found = sexy_groups(kind.size) |> collect()

    write_line("sexy prime {kind.name} below {limit}: {found.count}")

    primes()
